correctness.rationale: Full proof reduces the closure to finite prime-pattern products times an interval of tail products. The greedy subsum lemma is proved. For primes >=29 Nagura plus a geometric lower bound proves every weight is covered by its later tail; the five missing small-tail primes pass exact rational product inequalities. Four exact rational separating inequalities force all 16 low-prime bands apart. The density formula follows from local squarefree densities and CRT/squarefree sieve. check.py independently rechecks all finite arithmetic. An external unconditional Nagura theorem is used explicitly.

value.rationale: An explicit open problem in Defant 2015 asks for exact gap counts for restricted generalized divisor ranges. This natural cubic squarefree case has exactly 15 gaps, unlike previously analyzed quadratic squarefree and unrestricted cubic cases. The result identifies all 16 exact bands and all 16 positive local-pattern densities, with structural separation and tail-filling mechanisms that extend beyond a finite experiment.
